🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (Tech, Materials, Industrials positive) plus mixed megacap divergences (MSFT/NVDA ABOVE TREND but GOOGL BELOW TREND and several RECOVERY/CORRECTION signals), supporting a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leading: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials supportive: BA (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +11.33%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION. Utilities weak: VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND, SRE (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +13.72% | 1M: -12.17%) RECOVERY; ORCL (1W: +13.21% | 1M: +2.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology), Style: Growth/Momentum.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PSX (1W: -3.67% | 1M: +7.42%) CORRECTION; VLO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +6.48%) CORRECTION; F (1W: -4.77% | 1M: +2.72%) CORRECTION; MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND; VST (1W: -5.13% | 1M: -11.01%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and select consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +29.38% | 1M: +23.06%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +20.56% | 1M: +19.16%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large names (AAPL, META, QCOM, INTC, TSLA) show 1W vs 1M mismatches, so treat momentum as tactical, not fully confirmed for core allocation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but leading overall; NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: -0.51% | 1M: -1.28%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology: 18/24 positive (Sector Strength).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.99% | 1M: +4.11%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +7.60%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Financials: 14/20 positive (Internal Rotation).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed: JNJ (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +0.05%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -5.70%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 11/17 positive (Internal Rotation).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure toward cyclical leadership within current neutrality: select PLTR/SHOP/NEM and resilient Financials like JPM while reducing exposure to lagging Utilities and Energy names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but be selective given leadership concentration and major divergences.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +7.59% | 1M: +30.08%) ABOVE TREND; PLTR (1W: +39.78% | 1M: +33.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND; MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND; CVX (1W: -5.22% | 1M: +7.19%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (Sector Strength; Tech: 18/24 positive) and Materials (NEM, FCX ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Energy (Sector Weakness; Energy: 3/10 positive) and Utilities (Sector Weakness; Utilities: 2/10 positive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 1W resistance test near recent highs (watch continuation while ABOVE TREND). AAPL 1M support area as RECOVERY pivot (AAPL 1W: +1.43% | 1M: -0.91%) RECOVERY. JPM breakout continuation zone to confirm Financials strength (JPM 1W: +1.63% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly posts blowout growth and raises outlook; LLY (1W: +3.21% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY — news bullish but 1M negative signals partial divergence. CAT (+80): Caterpillar raises outlook; CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.09%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirms 1W strength despite 1M weakness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-80): FAA probe headline; BA (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +5.07%) ABOVE TREND — bearish news but price rising (divergence). CVS (-45): fee cut headline; CVS (1W: -8.36% | 1M: -6.34%) BELOW TREND — negative news confirmed by price weakness. MAR (-45): revenue miss talk; MAR (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given Tech and Materials leadership. MSFT and NVDA showing relative strength (MSFT ABOVE TREND; NVDA ABOVE TREND) while GOOGL and several staples are BELOW TREND or in RECOVERY. Key risk is concentrated leadership and major 1W/1M divergences—watch sentiment-driven names (LLY, BA, CVS) for confirmation or reversal.
